tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search Anclum's catalogue of MCP servers, agent skills and open-source AI projects, plus AI tools. Returns name, url, one-line summary and tags. Read-only.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one catalogue entry by its key (the slug used in its Anclum URL). Returns the full record: name, url, description, tags, source, first/last seen. Read-only.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the catalogue's taxonomies: AI-tool categories (with counts) and field tags (e.g. "MCP 服务", "Agent 技能"). Useful for then calling search_tools with a category. Read-only.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search Anclum's catalogue of MCP servers, agent skills and open-source AI projects, plus AI tools for people who are not developers. Returns name, url, one-line summary and tags. Read-only." → after: "Search Anclum's catalogue of MCP servers, agent skills and open-source AI projects, plus AI tools. Returns name, url, one-line summary and tags. Read-only."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
